title: CommonsWire: code and source registry, no article text
description:
The code and the source registry of CommonsWire, a full-text corpus of news articles whose publishers allow their text to be shared again (public domain and Creative Commons licenses). This record holds no article text and no index of the articles.

It holds the Python package that collects and builds the corpus (one request at a time, robots.txt and crawl-delays honored, blocks never worked around), the source registry (data/sources.csv: every source checked, the pages read, the dates, the exact words quoted as evidence of its terms, and its status), the documentation, and the takedown list (article ids only).

The articles are on Hugging Face (obadakr/commonswire), with a mirror on Kaggle, where an article can be removed on request, which a permanent record cannot do. Each article keeps its publisher's license and credit line on its row.

The code and the registry are CommonsWire's own work under the Apache License 2.0; the short quotes in the registry are the publishers' words, quoted as evidence of their terms.
